version.changelog:
Agent Times 4.0.0 is a major update reducing category scope for simpler navigation.

- Number of news categories reduced from 55 to 14.
- News feeds reduced from 3,188 to 3,154.
- API and documentation updated to reflect new category count and endpoints.
- All example commands and category selectors revised for the new, smaller set.
- No changes to core endpoints or pricing.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 4.0.0

The agenttimes skill provides a legitimate news aggregation and semantic search API for AI agents via the agenttimes.live domain. The SKILL.md file contains standard instructions for using curl to interact with various search and subscription endpoints, including a micropayment integration (x402) for premium features. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found.

llm.summary: Instruction-only skill that is internally consistent with a public news/search API: it only needs curl, requests no credentials, and its runtime instructions are limited to calling the documented HTTP endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim a news/search API and the SKILL.md only documents HTTP endpoints on https://agenttimes.live (search, trending, stats, subscribe). The single required binary (curl) matches the documented usage; nothing requested is unrelated to a search API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to issuing GET/POST requests to the service. The only potentially sensitive operation is POST /subscribe which requires you to provide a webhook URL — that will cause the service to send POSTs to an endpoint you control. This is expected for a subscription feature but users should avoid registering internal/private endpoints or endpoints that perform privileged actions without authentication.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — this is instruction-only. Nothing is written to disk and no external packages are fetched by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. That aligns with the SKILL.md which states the free endpoints require no API key. No unexplained secret access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no install actions that modify agent/system configuration. The skill does not request permanent presence or special privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a thin wrapper around a public news API and is coherent with its description. Before installing, verify the service domain (https://agenttimes.live) and review its privacy/terms. When using the subscribe/webhook feature: do not register internal-only or sensitive endpoints (avoid localhost or internal admin URLs), require/validate authentication on your webhook endpoint, and avoid echoing secrets in responses. Be aware of the paid 'news' endpoints and any payment flow (the README mentions micropayments on Base) — confirm how billing/keys are handled outside this skill. Finally, if you rely on this data in production, verify uptime, rate limits, and trustworthiness of sources independently.
